## Dave Sheltman
### Tenure
c. 1999 – c. 2017
**David Alan Sheltman** is a former Mattel employee who worked with Mattel from at least 1999 to about 2017. He was originally part of Hot Wheels' Innovation and Track groups, as well as working on "whatever needed his special attention". Mainly working on track sets and playsets, he also designed cars but not very often.
After his stint at Hot Wheels he then moved to Matchbox to design various large-scale vehicles and other non-diecast projects, such as Wrecky the Wrecking Buddy. Sheltman left Mattel around 2017; he currently works for Spin Master .
